pages.title: Auto Repair
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r III$(br2)§lApplicable to: §r Any damageable item$(br2)§lEffect: §r While held or worn, durability is restored every 5s: I restores 1-3 points, II restores 5-7 points, and III restores 10-12 points.$(br2)§lObtaining: §r Treasure-only, found in structure loot chests
